figures.finding: Screen Ireland lends experienced Irish writers up to €15,000 (€20,000 for teams) to take a feature from treatment to a first draft with an approved script editor; applicants need a produced fiction feature or TV drama writing credit and no producer attached.

value.eligibility: at least one produced fiction feature film or TV drama credit as writer; Irish citizen or resident; no producer attached

figures.applies: Irish writers and writer-director teams, live-action or animated features, 2026.

sources.said: Experienced Irish talent with at least one produced fiction feature film credit or TV drama credit, including animated TV shows, as a writer … €15,000 for individuals / €20,000 for teams … Please note producers should not be attached at this stage.

figures.finding: No collective agreement sets an Irish screenwriter's pay: Irish competition law lets self-employed workers bargain collectively only as voice-over actors, session musicians and freelance journalists, no order has added any other class, and the European screenwriters' federation reports Irish screenwriters have been prevented from collective bargaining by the national competition authority.

value.law: Competition Act 2002, Part 2B (ss. 15D-15F) and Schedule 4, inserted by the Competition (Amendment) Act 2017, commenced 2017-09-07

figures.applies: Ireland, self-employed screenwriters; checked against the Irish Statute Book as updated to 21 October 2026.

figures.finding: The Writers Guild of Ireland takes any professional writer on the island of Ireland: as an associate one still seeking a first scriptwriting credit, at EUR 60 a year; as a full member one with at least one paid, contracted scriptwriting credit, at EUR 60 to 215 a year by what the writer earns from writing in seven tiers; each after a 30-day trial.

associate.who: a professional writer on the island of Ireland without a produced scriptwriting credit

full.who: at least one professional scriptwriting credit, contracted and paid

figures.applies: Ireland and Northern Ireland, screenwriters, as the guild's page stood on 13 September 2026.

sources.said: Associate membership of the WGI is open to all professional writers on the island of Ireland, who are working on getting their first scriptwriting credit. … €0.00 now and then €60.00 per Year after your 30 day trial. … Full Membership of the WGI is open to all professional writers on the island of Ireland, with at least one professional scriptwriting credit, for which they received a contract and were paid. … Full Member - Tier 1 For writers earning up to €5,000 a year from their writing €0.00 now and then €60.00 per Year after your 30 day trial. … Full Member - Tier 7 For writers earning €50,000 and above a year from their writing €0.00 now and then €215.00 per Year after your 30 day trial.
